chapter: White bands and the old bands
title: Reliance band personnel and Drag's band
summary: Tom and the interviewer list the lighter-skinned musicians who played with the Reliance band, and Tom describes Drag's band and Willie Phillip, Poissy, Jack Carey and Louis Nelson.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
